# Vedanyaa Infotech

> Vedanyaa Infotech is a boutique software development company based in India, serving clients worldwide. We build custom ERP systems, MERN and Next.js applications, AI-driven apps, e-commerce platforms, PHP backends, and corporate websites.

## Services

- Custom ERP Solutions — inventory, HR, payroll, finance, CRM, analytics
- Informative & Corporate Websites — fast, SEO-ready, brand-focused
- Web Apps (React + Node) — TypeScript, APIs, auth, cloud deployment
- MERN Stack Development — MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js
- Next.js & Nest.js Apps — SSR/SSG, microservices, TypeScript end-to-end
- PHP Development — Laravel, CodeIgniter, REST APIs
- AI-Powered Web Experiences — GenAI chat, smart search, vector embeddings
- E-commerce Websites — Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, custom MERN stores
- AI-Driven Automation — RAG pipelines, AI agents, workflow automation, custom LLM apps

## Technologies

PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, React, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Express, Next.js, Nest.js, TanStack, AI/LLM, Shopify, WooCommerce, Vercel, Cloudflare
